title: Hollow Metallic and Dielectric Waveguides for Long Distance Optical Transmission and Lasers
citation: E. A. J. Marcatili & R. A. Schmeltzer · Bell System Technical Journal 43, 1783–1809 (1964)
role: Foundation of the circular hollow-waveguide modal model: characteristic equations, propagation constants and the wavelength² / radius³ loss scaling. The implementation uses approximate Bessel transverse profiles.

title: Waveguide-Loss Evaluation in Circular Hollow Waveguides and Its Ray-Optical Treatment
citation: M. Miyagi · Journal of Lightwave Technology 3, 303–307 (1985)
role: Connects modal attenuation with a ray-optics interpretation. Used in the accompanying derivation of losses; this web version propagates modal fields.

title: Loss characteristics of circular hollow waveguides for incoherent infrared light
citation: Y. Matsuura, M. Saito, M. Miyagi & A. Hongo · JOSA A 6, 423–427 (1989)
role: Background for multimode loss estimates, input-angle distributions and the effect of wall irregularities. Surface roughness is not included in the web solver.

title: Loss characteristics of infrared hollow waveguides in multimode transmission
citation: M. Saito, S. Sato & M. Miyagi · JOSA A 10, 277–282 (1993)
role: Relates wave and geometric descriptions of multimode attenuation, including the dependence on launch angle and bore radius.

title: Coupling Losses in Hollow Waveguide Laser Resonators
citation: R. L. Abrams · IEEE Journal of Quantum Electronics 8, 838–843 (1972)
role: Background for field-to-mode coupling and the lowest hybrid mode. Its laser-resonator geometry is not simulated here.

title: Effect of field regeneration on the TEM₀₀ transmission characteristics of a circular-section waveguide
citation: R. M. Jenkins & R. W. J. Devereux · Applied Optics 31, 5086–5091 (1992)
role: Physical context for coherent modal superposition and regeneration of transverse fields as relative phases evolve along the guide.

title: Express Analysis of Gas With Surface Enhanced Raman Scattering Waveguide Resonator
citation: M. N. Khannanov, A. B. Vankov, V. E. Kirpichev, L. V. Kulik & I. V. Kukushkin · IEEE Sensors Journal 21, 24142–24148 (2021)
role: Experimental motivation for the silver-coated waveguide and Raman project. The calculator does not predict SERS enhancement or establish a plasmonic mechanism.
